Aspera Connect companion — phone install
========================================

Version: 0.3.6 (signed v1+v2+v3) — refreshes phone IP when Wi‑Fi band changes

  rm -f /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk
  curl -L --http1.1 -o /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk \
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk"
  # expect sha256 2215e20113d55f540984a309381f3fa8ee27ad9e22e1b84f8f1184f2fc71147b
  sha256sum /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk
  adb install -t /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk

If that fails:
  adb uninstall com.asperaconnect.companion || true
  adb install -r -t /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk
